material_results: Multi-agent C54 is independently reproducible from its frozen deterministic seeded script. All replayed headline quality deltas, confidence half-widths and asymmetric negative-result values match the worker to displayed precision. Equal-marginal evaluator switching loses measurable value as synthetic cross-error dependence rises; a materially better evaluator remains useful even at full synthetic cross dependence, while the asymmetric error regime gives no reliable archive-level gain under the current naive LR controller.

The real-LLM evaluator-panel analogue in arXiv:2605.29800 reports 9 judges from 7 families, mean pairwise phi=0.391, Kish n_eff=2.18, panel 72.0% versus best individual 71.8%. This supports the qualitative shared-error concern only; it does not calibrate C54's cross_mix or sequential evidence-per-call metric.

Failure-evidence FE-074 is primary-paper verified: the GPT-5 proposer-pruner uses 10 iterations, 6 proposals pruned to 3, optimization objective side-task-success x undetected-rate, and optimizer-blind held-out/transfer sets. Just Ask APPS rises about 28% to 68%; strong-monitor APPS objective 30% to 60%, BashArena 10% to 25%; self-incrimination APPS 5% to 22.5% and BashArena 0% to 35%. The paper explicitly says side-task success lacks a common upward trend, so the observed undetected-success growth is mainly attributed to evasion.

The official FE-074 code confirms the experiment mechanism and split logic, but paper-producing history.json/.eval logs are not tracked in the inspected current repository and logs are explicitly gitignored. Therefore the numerical results are primary-paper verified plus code-mechanism verified, not independently replayed from released raw logs.
